reference.name: Initial Open issues control includes closed issues
reference.summary: Clicking the Open count from the unfiltered issue list navigates to state=all and includes a closed issue.
reference.expected: Clicking Open should display only open issues.
reference.actual: Clicking the Open count from the unfiltered issue list navigates to state=all and includes a closed issue.
reproSteps: Open the seeded repository Issues list with no state filter and note the separate Open and Closed counts.
Click Open and observe state=all in the URL and a closed issue in the resulting list.

knownHits.reason: Matches the initial Open count navigating to state=all and including closed items, through the same repository-list interaction on pull requests.

reference.name: New-file commit message placeholder exposes {filename} token
reference.summary: After entering a filename in the New File editor, the commit-message placeholder still displays the literal template token {filename}.
reference.expected: The commit-message placeholder should use the entered filename or generic wording without an unresolved template token.
reference.actual: The Commit Changes form displays the literal placeholder “Add '{filename}'”.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval with password momentic-eval-1 and open eval/harbor-handbook.
Create a disposable branch from main using the branch selector.
Choose Add File > New File and enter a Markdown filename and a line of content.
Scroll to Commit Changes without submitting and inspect the commit-message placeholder.
Observe the literal {filename} token in the placeholder instead of the entered filename.

knownHits.reason: Matches the New File commit-message placeholder retaining the literal {filename} token after a filename is entered.
